approvers: my adviser/broker, my tax adviser, my family, and the buyer's bank
reason: A Belize shell with no track record and no committed funding wants my life's work? No. My business lives on my personal relationships and I will not hand it to a company I cannot check.
objection: A newly formed offshore company with no money committed and no references. I would be selling to a stranger who may not be able to pay, and 30% over three years is on their promise alone.
instead: Keep running the business, look for a buyer through my adviser or nexxt-change, or find someone from the trade or a known German buyer with a bank letter and references.
would_change_my_mind: Funds actually committed and proven by a German bank, a German or EU-based entity, and references from owners they have bought from. Part of the 30% would have to be secured as well.
